title: Private Memory Proof 001
purpose: Create a short emotionally legible proof from the real family archive showing how photographs, objects, oral history, generations and the UrAi memory world become one connected experience.

realArchiveAnchors.use: open with a vivid ordinary-life memory; water, boat, person and companion animal
show how an ordinary physical object carries family history across generations
connect rural/farm identity to a younger generation without inventing date or location
show family continuity moving forward into the next generation
show that the family already preserves identity through pictures, art, faith, service and objects in the home
use the informal marriage-origin story as the emotional narration spine once original audio is source-verified
bridge the family's older slide/projector memory practice to UrAi as a living continuation, not a replacement

story.treatment: Begin with real ordinary family life, move through objects and generations, let the family's own oral history reveal meaning the photographs cannot contain, then show UrAi connecting those fragments into a navigable private memory world.

editPlan.treatment: Open on the real lake/boat memory with restrained motion and natural sound. No synthetic face reconstruction.
Macro-style crop across the real family watch while narration introduces the idea that objects outlive the stories attached to them unless somebody records why they matter.
Use the real tractor image as a generational/rural anchor. Do not assert an unverified date, place or person beyond private source authority.
Use the family's real informal marriage-origin recollection, including its humor, only after original audio verification. Do not synthesize or clone missing speech.
Move from older memories to real graduation imagery to make the generational continuity visible.
Use the real home display as evidence that memory already lives in rooms, objects, portraits, art and small family arrangements.
Transition the real archive into exact-head UrAi capture: object, person, place, relationship, story and generation become connected memory nodes. Generated UI substitution is forbidden.
Return to real source imagery and close on the idea that this proof uses only a small fraction of the family archive. Encourage continued storytelling without implying the archive is complete.
